For this collectible version of Billy Reid’s iconic Dover Sweatshirt, they’ve embroidered Billy’s original “Kissing Hummingbirds” design to the chest using a chain stitch technique. It also features Billy Reid’s signature distressed leather elbow patches, piping details at the armhole, subtle herringbone twill detailing throughout, and a special collaboration patch at the back bottom left hem.
